clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Gallywix's Head proves that a Venture Company overseer was executed. The Shattered Hand demands the trophy as proof of the killing.

Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix directed the Venture Company's work from its tower north of the Sludge Fen. When word arrived that the Venture Co. planned something on a grand scale, the Shattered Hand sent operatives to dismantle the facility. Bringing Gallywix's head to Shenthul in Orgrimmar proves the overseer was executed and secures the rogue's standing within the guild.
